scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @krayon/shared && npm run build -w @krayon/pipeline && ([ -f local-backend/.env ] || cp local-backend/.env.example local-backend/.env)
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @krayon/shared && npm run build -w @krayon/pipeline && concurrently -k -n shared,pipeline,backend,frontend -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:pipeline" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @krayon/shared && npm run build -w @krayon/pipeline && npm run build -w @krayon/api && npm run build -w local-backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @krayon/shared && npm run test -w @krayon/pipeline && npm run test:backend:quick
scripts.test:emulators: echo 'Opt-in only. Not run from this task. When the Firestore adapter suite exists: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage npm run test -w @krayon/pipeline'
scripts.lint: eslint packages/shared/src packages/pipeline/src packages/api/src packages/renderer/src local-backend/src backend/src
